runtime_fixture.note: Real signer/floor files; selection and ledger storage are fake maps; OCI interfaces are the direct fake, no httptest server reached.

runtime.note: Actual calls and local transitions; SDK and object calls terminate at fixture implementations.

selection.note: Selector object reads are fake; real floor Check and Observe are prerequisites, distinguished from the target assertions.

signer.note: Actual material directory and protected key file open/stat/read/hash; missing or wrong file is core evidence for signer roots only.

fake_oci.note: Direct in-process fake interfaces, never OCI SDK HTTP transport.

fake_ledger.note: Ledger validates real records but client reads/writes a Go map, not network or production persistent storage.

gate_fixture.note: Admissible release helper converts seed-a to controller-c and installs correct topology; actual helper, not fixture name, determines admission path.

gate.note: Pending retry and successful initial/restart admission invoke actual marker and public launch material paths. Binary, instance and live credential checks are fixture implementations.

marker.note: Exact production accepted marker read/write/readback boundary; no live credentials inferred.

peer_floor.note: Production continuation verifies bindings before ownership preparation and floor publication.

local_completion.note: Seed restart checks existing floor and completion fact; successful mark is best effort, not asserted direct readback.

floor_fixture.note: Real temp directories and optional root-to-service chown; ancestors relaxed only for test directories.

floor.note: Production openat/stat/flock/read/write/fsync/rename boundary supports all floor assertions.

spans.function: Initialize / InitializeForService / inspect / openDirectory / withLock / read / writeNew / encodeFounderSelectionFloor

floor_owner.note: Ownership is applied to actual lock file and synced.

qualification_limits: Runtime UNKNOWN_NO_RECEIPTS_REVIEWED_NO_EXECUTION for every root; no compile or pass/fail claims.
OCI and Object Storage are direct Go fakes/maps here; httptest server in another unallocated root is never invoked by these paths.
Floor and signer reads in successful fake-driven runtime roots are incidental unless their own file behavior is the assertion target.
Peer gates retain fake binary, material, credential, descriptor, instance and identity-observer callbacks; file admission does not qualify those external facts.
File paths exercise local publication/readback only; no crash/power loss, live cloud, production credential or fleet qualification.
Service ownership test branches depend on runner UID/GID; no privilege or resource probe performed.
No ledger/count/source/runtime mutation or retirement/deletion/completion credit. All safety obligations retained.
